newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, nickel extend losses.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, nickel extend losses.

text.p: Indian copper and nickel prices fell while other metals were steady on Thursday, dealers said.
Ready nickel fell by 300 rupees to 37,500 rupees on increased arrivals coupled with reports of weak overseas trends.
Copper slid by 50 rupees to 11,700 rupees on fresh offerings by stockists and importers. Zinc was steady at 6,225 rupees, lead at 4,925, aluminium at 7,250 and tin at 35,600.
"The industrial sector in India is going through a recession which in turn has affected demand for non-ferrous metals considerably," said Sharad Parikh, president of the Bombay Metal Exchange.
